article.story: MONROE, La. -- — Phat Phat Brooks and Conrad Luczynski scored 14 points apiece and Keenan Garner added a double-double to lead Central Michigan to an 83-78 victory over UL Monroe on Monday night in a season opener. Brooks also had six assists for the Chippewas, while Luczynski added three blocks. Garner totaled 11 points and 10 rebounds. Quaran McPherson led the way for the Warhawks with 24 points. Dayjaun Anderson had 19 points and Ziyade Ndancky pitched in with 14 points, nine rebounds and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
